dealer_positioning.volatility_behavior: If cash SPX opens and holds below 7699-7738, modeled short-gamma hedging can reinforce selling into declines and buying into rebounds, raising gap-follow-through and intraday trend risk. The 7700 put concentration, followed by 7650 and 7600, marks potential hedging-sensitive downside zones; I Love Vol estimates -8.1B of strike gamma at 7600 and -7.3B at 7650. A recovery above 7723-7744 could moderate hedging feedback in near-spot models, but the GEX Metrix wider flip at 7903 disagrees. Gamma effects are conditional, not price forecasts.
